description: $0.02 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]; not covered by the free trial). [SEO, security and site verdicts] One call answers two questions agents ask about a website: what risk signals does it show before you click or pay (url-trust, trust/2: TLS, redirects, domain age via RDAP, lookalike/punycode, scam/parked signals, x402 challenge validity, each with evidence, a risk level low_observed_risk / elevated / high / unknown and measured error rates; never a "safe" claim) and is it ready for AI agents and search (agent-readiness score 0-100), plus a security-headers summary. Returns overall risk level and scores, top fixes and the three full sub-results. Method and error rates: https://shop.lordevo.com/docs/trust-methodology
